dimensions.assessment: Affects Tribal Governments, Tribal entities, and federal departments including Agriculture, Commerce, and Housing and Urban Development.
dimensions.evidence: available to Tribal entities (as defined in subsection (e) of section 309 of the Federal Crop Insurance Reform and Department of Agriculture Reorganization Act of 1994)

dimensions.assessment: Effects are administrative and procedural, aimed at reducing burdens and improving consultation rather than altering personal rights or direct benefits.
dimensions.evidence: develop interagency agreements to reduce administrative and planning burdens for applicants to such programs

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not authorize specific appropriations or spending amounts for these consultations and working groups.
Amends existing statutory provisions under the Federal Crop Insurance Reform and Department of Agriculture Reorganization Act of 1994 and sets up interagency task forces.
dimensions.evidence: Section 309 of the Federal Crop Insurance Reform and Department of Agriculture Reorganization Act of 1994 (7 U.S.C. 6921) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual consultations and periodic updates to repositories every two years.
dimensions.evidence: consultation with Tribal Governments on at least an annual basis

missing_information: Specific funding levels or appropriations required to carry out the interagency task forces and reporting mechanisms.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes formal consultation processes and reporting requirements regarding Department of Agriculture programs and budgets for Tribal Governments and entities, creating interagency task forces and public repositories without sweeping nationwide regulatory changes.
